🎯 Media Buyer — every live ad 82

Meta data pulled 28/11/2026 01:35 PM (this PC's time). Numbers are the last 7 days unless the column name says otherwise. View only: nothing on this page changes an ad. Hover a column name to see what it means.

📖 What do these words mean?

ROAS = sales value / ad spend. 2.0 = $2 of sales for every $1 spent. Break-even is 2.04.

MER = all ad spend as a share of all Shopify sales. Lower is better. Ideal is about 15.6%.

CPP = cost per purchase: ad spend / sales.

CPC link = the cost of one click to the website.

CTR link = out of 100 people who see the ad, how many click.

$ / cart = ad spend for each add to cart.

Cart → buy = out of 100 carts, how many turn into a sale. Low = a website or price problem, not the ad.

Freq = how many times the same person saw the ad. Over 2.5 = people are getting tired of it.

Hook (videos) = out of 100 people, how many watched 3 seconds.

Campaign → ad set → ad = the folder, the group inside it, and the actual ad people see.

Campaign budget = one daily amount Meta shares across the ad sets. Minimum spend forces Meta to give one ad set at least that much, even when it is losing. We never use it.

Learning = Meta is still working out who buys. Adding or editing ads, or a big budget change, restarts it.

TOF / TOM / MOF / BOF = cold new people / everyone except buyers / warm visitors / past buyers.

Profit (7d) = sales value x 49% gross margin, minus ad spend. A rough guide.

Villain pause · Supervillain pause now · Sidekick keep and watch · Hero keep · Superhero keep and give more budget · Civilian too early to tell (under $150 spent).
